label: Machine Learning on Graphs
title: Graph Machine Learning
desc: Graph neural networks for combinatorial optimization (minimum dominating set, minimum vertex cover), code vulnerability detection, and brain connectomics. The NeuroGraph benchmark provides 35 graph datasets spanning behavioral and cognitive traits for reproducible research in neuroimaging.

label: Distributed Systems · Fault Tolerance
title: Resilient Multi-Agent Systems
desc: Byzantine-resilient consensus and distributed learning using the centerpoint theorem. Applications include multi-robot pursuit, distributed SGD under adversarial attacks, GNN-based flocking control, and resilient multi-agent reinforcement learning.

label: Control Theory · Combinatorics
title: Network Controllability & Robustness
desc: Strong structural controllability via zero forcing sets and distance-based bounds, with algorithms for leader selection and edge augmentation. PMI sequences and their tight bounds connect discrete geometry to network controllability.

label: Computational Geometry · Algorithms
title: Discrete & Computational Geometry
desc: Centerpoint theorem, ray-shooting depth, and k-centerpoint conjectures in ℝ<sup>d</sup>. Affine-invariant statistical depth measures and their algorithms. PhD thesis: hitting sets in convex ranges from Rutgers (Fulbright, 2014).
